restated: An adversary with existing access to Windows hosts on this network harvested credentials from those hosts.
what_would_confirm: LSASS memory access or dumping (e.g., procdump, comsvcs.dll MiniDump, Mimikatz), SAM/SECURITY hive or NTDS.dit extraction, suspicious access to credential stores, or use of stolen credentials from those hosts.
what_would_refute: No evidence of credential-dumping tooling, no anomalous access to LSASS/SAM/credential stores, and no subsequent authentication using credentials originating from the compromised hosts.
